trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: No separate job: this is the punch-out at the end of the last shift. It pops the moment the other 54 trophies are stamped, so work the six shifts in order and let this one land last. Nothing to chase directly, everything to finish first.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Clock in with the opening mission Gone Fishing and play it to its end cutscene. First mission, first stamp: follow the prompts and do not wander off to side play until it pops.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. A story-only stamp: keep the chapters moving in order and it lands when the chapter closes. No side work needed for it.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same rule as every chapter trophy: play the story missions in order and the stamp comes with the chapter's end.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Shift 2 is the Vice City stretch: run the chapter missions as they open and this stamps itself at the chapter's close.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last chapter stamp before the finale: play the chapter through in shift 3 and it lands with the closing mission.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Save it for the last shift: the finale only counts once, so finish the side work you care about first, then close the story and take the gold.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story mission stamp: play it when it opens in shift 1 and move on to the next job.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. A heist mission: do the prep, then run it. The stamp comes with the getaway, so see the job through to the end.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story only: play the mission when it opens in shift 2 and the stamp follows the ending.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A shift 3 story mission: run it when it opens and stay with it to the end cutscene.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. An airport job in shift 3: follow the mission's plan and the stamp lands when the takedown is done.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A shift 3 story operation: see it through to the end and the stamp is yours.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The long shift: every mission, strand, activity and collectible the game counts. Use the checklist here and the Grind board to find what is left, and treat this as the last stamp before the platinum.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. A pure grind: chain jumps, near misses and airtime whenever you are driving between jobs, and watch the counter on the Grind board. Do not sit down to do all 250 at once; let them pile up across shifts 1 to 5 and mop up the rest here.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 250). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Sample them all: one try each is enough. Tick them off on the Grind board as you go; the types you skipped in earlier shifts are the ones to mop up here.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 9). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The hardest grind on the board: learn each challenge's timing first, then chase gold one weapon class at a time. A few challenges a day beats a marathon session.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 42). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn a track before you race it for the win: a clean line matters more than raw speed, and a lost race still teaches the course.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 14). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Twenty distinct race wins: vary the events instead of repeating one favourite, and the count climbs on its own as you work the race list.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 20). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Challenge Cal, watch how he fishes, then beat him at his own game. One focused attempt after you have learned the fishing rhythm.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, play one game to the end. The easiest stamp on the board: grab it on any slow evening between shifts.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play Andy's strand to its last mission in shift 4; the stamp comes with the strand's ending.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play Kenton's strand through to its last mission in shift 4.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's strand through to its last mission in shift 4.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Eight stranger strands, spread across the state. Start them as you meet the strangers in shift 4 and finish each strand before moving on: a strand left half-done is a strand forgotten.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 8). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's strand through to its last mission in shift 4.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's strand through to its last mission in shift 4.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. Fold it into travel: when a meditation spot is near your route, stop and stamp it instead of making a separate trip for each one.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 18). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Track the unique animal Bret wants and take it down cleanly. One hunt, one stamp: do not leave it for the last shift.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Three full card sets. Pick up cards as you find them and check the Grind board for which sets are one card short, then hunt that last card.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 3). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Tag 100 spots. Treat it as background work: tag whenever you pass a fresh spot instead of hunting all 100 in one run, and the counter does the rest.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 100). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Fifty challenges of any kind: the counter ticks up as you play, so check the Grind board and chase the challenge types you are closest on.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 50). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: ALARM: one clean escape at a 4 star wanted level with your partner beside you. Build the wanted level deliberately, then break line of sight together. If the escape fails, set it up and try again.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: ALARM: three shops in a row, wanted level intact throughout, partner with you. Plan the route first: three close shops, no detours. Then run it in one go.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive everything you see: a new vehicle discovered is a tick. Variety beats speed, so hop into the odd ones, not just the fast ones.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 100). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: ALARM: five takedowns inside one Combat Focus. Wait for a crowded fight, trigger focus, and count to five. A quiet street will not give you the crowd.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: ALARM: leave the airport your own way, not through the front door. The description points at VCIA, so improvise the exit and the stamp follows.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: ALARM: the Rhinos in the description are the hint. Find one, take it for a spin, and let the chaos count.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: ALARM: in and out unseen. Case the store, go when it is quiet, and leave before anyone notices. One alarm and the attempt is spent, so plan it before you walk in.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vaults, five clean escapes. Space them out: a vault run is a shift's work, not a coffee break.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 5). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: ALARM: hit the truck, grab the take, and break away before the response arrives. Pick a quiet road for the hit so the escape is yours.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The Grind board tracks which areas are still blank: sweep the map region by region in shift 5 until none are left.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 52). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: ALARM: one illegal operation per gang, nine gangs. Keep a list of which gangs you have hit: the ninth is the one people forget.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 9). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: ALARM: do it early, while you are still in the opening stretch. One cocktail, one ocean view: the cheapest stamp in the game if you grab it in shift 1.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: ALARM: a showroom exit, done loudly. Drive in, then drive straight out through the glass in classic style.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: ALARM: finish what you start at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. A full game, bowled through to the end.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: ALARM: the description is deliberately vague, a partnership moment in the story. Play the partnership beats when they come and do not skip the scene.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Five hundred choices tracked by PSN: the count climbs across the whole game, so this is a background stamp. Check the Grind board late in shift 5.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 500). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: ALARM: the name says it, the second attempt is the one that counts. If a setup fails once, go straight back in.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: ALARM: a strange moment out in the world. Keep your eyes open in shift 5: the odd ones do not announce themselves twice.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: ALARM: pins down with a melee drive-by at the lanes. Line it up, swing through, and count the pins.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count where shown). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. A quarter of a million through the laundering contacts. Bank the bills as you earn them: the Grind board tracks the running total.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 250000). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy what the builds need and the total takes care of itself: do not blow it on one spree.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 100000). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Save it for shift 5, when the money is there: garages are a late purchase, not an early one.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 8). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register the odd ones as you discover them and the tenth lands on its own.
trophies.sources: Exophase official list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (PSN count of 10). Advice is our own reading of the official description, not yet checked in the game.
